svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: cost per wear of two T-shirts
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. A made-up 8 dollar T-shirt worn 20 times costs 40 cents a wear. A made-up 24 dollar T-shirt worn 80 times costs 30 cents a wear. The bars show those two costs per wear. They are not store prices.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: cost per wear
Not a Joe Fresh, George, or Old Navy price. Longer bar means a higher cost per wear.
$8 divided by 20 is $0.40. $24 divided by 80 is $0.30.
The same $24 tee worn only 20 times would be $1.20 a wear, and the cheap tee would win.
Count wears you will get, not wears you hope for. Growth shortens a child's count.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. As of 29 Sep 2026.
